meta.note: HAND-WRITTEN FAKE DATA. Shape is the contract the vision pipeline must emit. Times are wall-clock ISO-8601 with offset. Two rides by the presenter (consenting): ride 1 south on the 2nd Ave protected bike lane (Battery St → S Jackson St); ride 2 a South Lake Union loop from the venue at 1700 Westlake Ave N (Westlake & Denny → Westlake & Harrison → Valley St → 9th Ave N → Thomas St → Westlake & Harrison). See meta.rides. Cameras are real SDOT camera IDs and coordinates; CMR-0415 is marked dead on purpose to exercise the lost/reacquire path.
meta.ground_truth_note: Presenter waves at each corridor camera while passing; GPS/phone timestamps logged. Compared against linked subject sightings per camera to give precision/recall. Additive to the frozen contract; no existing shape changed.
meta.cameras_note: First 18 = demo corridor + neighbours (hand-picked). Remaining = every SDOT camera in the downtown vicinity (Denny→S Jackson, waterfront→I-5) from data/sdot.json; alive=true is an assumption until the health checker runs.
